decisions.reason: As a renamed and evidently well-accepted evolution of the earlier BASIC 518, this compact modular trommel screen looks like a proven product line we would normally continue.
The 2019 upgrade of the whole AK series to EU Stage V suggests ongoing compliance investment and a continuing market role, even if the website emphasis was more limited than for some other products.
The move from a website mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 points to growing commercial importance, so a German machinery producer would usually keep it in the portfolio.
Management would be unlikely to withdraw a product that was still presented prominently in 2019 and described as setting standards in its segment.
